entries.title: A new install no longer takes words before it knows a subscription is connected
entries.body: In the first moment after opening a new install, the message box could send words before the app had checked whether a subscription was connected. Firstmate could not answer them, the sign-in choices gave way to a card, and the welcome was skipped. The message box now waits for that check, which takes a split second, and the welcome arrives once you connect.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen looks different: the message box only waits for the split second before the app has checked.
